name: Jungle Mess Kit
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot —; Price 500 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This crucial piece of survival gear guarantees safe use of the most basic of consumables. The hinged metal container acts as a cook pot and opens to reveal a cup, plate, and eating utensils. Whether facing stagnant pond water or worm-infested small game, this kit renders any spoiled, rotten, or even poisonous food safe to consume. It can purify only mundane, natural ill effects and functions on up to 1 cu. ft. of food and drink, 3/day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells purify food and drink; Cost 250 gp
